lessons: The diff breaks 3 tests in tests/test_host_loop.py: the fixture serve never merges its machine ticket before the wait times out. Run `uv run pytest tests/test_host_loop.py` before committing, and make it pass.

eval/host_loop.py:111 starts a real `python -m chupa serve` with cwd at a fixture host repo and a restricted env (line 92). Check that the startup tree-id read and the per-admission tree-id read both succeed there and return the same ids, so admission is never held.

Read the tree ids from the engine checkout (parent of the imported `chupa/` package), never from serve's cwd or host repo. A fixture merge in the host repo must not count as an engine change, as the ticket's docs-only criterion requires.
If a tree-id read fails, do not treat it as a change and do not stall admission silently. Follow the ticket's non-git path: one engine_log event saying self-upgrade is off, then no watching.

Run the full `uv run pytest -q` after the final commit. The run record says 3230 passed, but Check saw 3227 passed and 3 errors. If the host_loop errors also show up on the base commit, file them in the Suggestion Box instead of changing eval/.
